audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Beat Drop as the punishable cooldown but gives no actual number, and never mentions Rakan's own E has 0 cooldown, which is the real reason the dive cycle works.
audit.why: Seraphine's E (Beat Drop) is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 by rank and her R is 160/140/120 — those are the numbers that make 'dodge it and dive' concrete. Rakan's E (Battle Dance) has cd 0, which is why the W-in/E-out cycle can repeat freely.
audit.corrected: - Seraphine Beat Drop (E) is 11s at rank 1, down to 9s at rank 5 — dodge it and the song never builds. It writes your spacing rules. - Battle Dance (E) has no cooldown — hop freely. - Encore (R) is 160/140/120s, a rare punish window; pick one target per cast.
